IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p571/r10.claim: The two women at the well are Shuʿayb’s daughters.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p571/r10.anchor: والثامن : إبنتا شعيب . ومنه قوله تعالى [ في القصص ] :

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p571/r11.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p571/r11.speaker: مقاتل
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p571/r11.claim: Muqātil names the elder daughter Ṣabūra and the younger ʿAbrā, and says they were twins.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p571/r11.anchor: قال مقاتل : واسم الكبرى ، منهما صبورا . والصغرى [ عبرا ] وكانتا توأما

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p615/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p615/r5.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p615/r5.claim: One Quranic face of وجد is finding or coming upon something, illustrated by the queen and the two women at the watering place.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p615/r5.anchor: وذكر بعض المفسرين أن وجد في القرآن على ستة أوجه : -

MAJAZ:v2p100/r4.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v2p100/r4.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v2p100/r4.claim: Ummah here means a group of people.
MAJAZ:v2p100/r4.anchor: «وجد عليه أمة من الناس يسقون» (23) أي جماعة..

MAJAZ:v2p100/r5.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v2p100/r5.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v2p100/r5.claim: Tadhūdāni means prevent, repel, or drive away; Jarīr and Saʿīd b. Kurāʿ’s verses illustrate it. The latter also mentions the jinn’s wild camels in local lore.
MAJAZ:v2p100/r5.anchor: «تذودان» (23) مجازه: تمنعان وتردان وتطردان قال جرير: وقد سلبت عصاك بنو تميم

ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r5.claim: Madyan is genitive but indeclinable because it is a place name.
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r5.anchor: لكنه لا ينصرف لأنه اسم للبقعة

ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r6.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r6.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r6.claim: أمة means a group of people.

ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r7.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r7.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r7.claim: The women kept their sheep from the water because stronger men at the watering place drove them away.
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r7.anchor: عن الماء من هو على السقي أقوى منهما

ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r8.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r8.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r8.claim: ما خطبكما asks their situation or purpose: what they intend by keeping their flock from the water.
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r8.anchor: ما تريدان بذودكما غنمكما عن الماء

ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r9.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r9.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r9.claim: With yuṣdiru, shepherds make their flocks return after watering; with yaṣduru, the shepherds themselves return.

ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r10.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r10.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p138/r10.claim: الرعاء is plural of راع, as صحاب is plural of صاحب.

IBNMUJAHID:v1p492/r3.author: Ibn Mujāhid
IBNMUJAHID:v1p492/r3.speaker: أبو عمرو وابن عامر
IBNMUJAHID:v1p492/r3.claim: Abu ʿAmr and Ibn ʿĀmir read يصدر with fatḥa on yāʾ and ḍamma on dāl from ṣadara; others use rafʿ on yāʾ and kasra on dāl from aṣdara.
IBNMUJAHID:v1p492/r3.anchor: فقرأ أبو عمرو وابن عامر ﴿ حتى يصدر ﴾ بنصب الياء وضم الدال من صدرت

NASHR:v1p387/r4.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p387/r4.speaker: نافع وابن كثير وأبو عمرو وأبو جعفر ورويس
NASHR:v1p387/r4.claim: A sixth, reverse-vowel class has no exact word but occurs in meaning in Qasas; these five readers realize the first hamza and soften the second, using between-between or pure waw/ya according to class.
NASHR:v1p387/r4.anchor: فقرأ نافع وابن كثير وأبو عمرو وأبو جعفر ورويس بتحقيق الهمزة الأولى وتسهيل الهمزة الثانية

NASHR:v2p341/r4.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p341/r4.speaker: أبو جعفر وابن عامر
NASHR:v2p341/r4.claim: Abū Jaʿfar and Ibn ʿĀmir read the yāʾ with fatḥa and dāl with ḍamma; the others use ḍamma on yāʾ and kasra on dāl.
NASHR:v2p341/r4.anchor: يصدر الرعاء فقرأ أبو جعفر وابن عامر بفتح الياء وضم الدال،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p278#5/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p278#5/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p278#5/r2.claim: Dhāda means to drive away or push back.

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r4.claim: Moses reached a well where a large group watered their livestock; the two women stood below them and kept their sheep away to avoid mixing with the flock.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r4.anchor: وصل إليه وهو بئر كانوا يسقون منها

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r5.claim: The women held their sheep back from the water; they waited until the shepherds moved their animals away to avoid crowding with men.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r5.anchor: تمنعان أغنامهما عن الماء لئلا تختلط بأغنامهم

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r6.claim: The object of the women’s watering is omitted because the point is their modesty and the reason Moses would be prompted to water for them.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r6.anchor: وحذف المفعول لأن الغرض هو بيان ما يدل على عفتهما ويدعوه إلى السقي لهما

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r7.speaker: أبو عمرو وابن عامر
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r7.claim: Abū ʿAmr and Ibn ʿĀmir read يصدر, meaning that the shepherds depart.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r7.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو وابن عامر »يصدر« أي ينصرف

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r8.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r8.claim: Another reading has الرعاء with ḍamma; it is a collective noun like الرخال.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r8.anchor: وقرىء » الرعاء« بالضم وهو اسم جمع كالرخال

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r9.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r9.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r9.claim: Their father was elderly and unable to go out to water the flock, so the women had to do it.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:21-23/r9.anchor: كبير السن لا يستطيع أن يخرج للسقي فيرسلنا اضطرارا

BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r9.claim: Moses reaches the watering place intending to drink; it is the water from which shepherds draw.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r9.anchor: حضور من يشرب { ماء مدين } اي الذي يستقي منها الرعاء

BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r10.claim: He finds a large group tending livestock, a powerful crowd that occupies and dominates access to the water.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r10.anchor: جماعة كثيرة هم أهل لأن يقصدوا ويقصدوا , فلذلك هم عالون غالبون على الماء

BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r11.claim: The object of ‘watering’ is omitted because the action itself is what matters in the description.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r11.anchor: وحذف المفعول لأنه غير مراد , والمراد الفعل

BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r12.claim: The two women stand nearer the approach to the water than the group, and their designation as women points to their noble character revealed later.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r12.anchor: بذلك لما جعل لهما سبحانه من المروءة ومكارم الأخلاق

BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r13.claim: Tadhūdān means they restrain, prevent, and drive away their thirsty sheep to keep them from mixing with other flocks.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r13.anchor: وهو الكف والمنع والطرد وارتكاب أخف الضررين

BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r14.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r14.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r14.claim: Moses’ compassion concerns the acts of restraining and withholding water, not the fact that the animals are sheep.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p475/r14.anchor: فإن رحمته عليه الصلاة والسلام لم تكن لكون المذود والمسقي غنما

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p226#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p226#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p226#2/r4.claim: At Midian's well, Moses saw a crowd watering sheep and two women holding their flock back to avoid harm; they waited for the shepherds to finish because their father was elderly.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p226#2/r4.anchor: وكان لها بئر ترده رعاء الشاء

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p226#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p226#2/r5.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p226#2/r5.claim: Umar reports that ten men alone could lift the stone covering Midian's well; Moses lifted it and drew one bucketful until the sheep were watered. Ibn Kathir grades the chain sound.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p226#2/r5.anchor: عن عمر بن الخطاب، رضي الله عنه، أن موسى

JISHUMI:v8p5484/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r1.speaker: أبو جعفر وأبو عمرو وابن عامر
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r1.claim: These readers, along with al-Hasan and al-Sulami, read yaṣdura with open yāʾ and ḍamma dāl: the shepherds themselves return from the water.
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r1.anchor: قرأ أبو جعفر وأبو عمرو وابن عامر: حتى يصدر بفتح الياء وضم الدال

JISHUMI:v8p5484/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r2.claim: Other readers use passive yuṣdira with ḍamma yāʾ and kasra dāl, meaning the shepherds return their livestock from the water.
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r2.anchor: الباقون بضم الياء وكسر الدال، أي: حتى يرجعوا مواشيهم عن الماء.

JISHUMI:v8p5484/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r6.claim: Khaṭb and shaʾn are near-synonyms for affair; khaṭb particularly denotes a consequential matter, as in words for sermons and addresses.
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r6.anchor: والخطب والشأن من النظائر، يقال: ما خطبك؛ أي: ما شأنك؟ والخطب: الأمر الذي فيه تفخيم

JISHUMI:v8p5484/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r7.claim: Ṣudūr is leaving the watering place; aṣdara means to make someone leave. Maṣdar is associated with the source from which plans or actions issue.
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r7.anchor: والصدر: الانصراف عن الماء، صدر يصدر، وأصدر غيره إصدارا، ومنه: المصدر

JISHUMI:v8p5484/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r8.claim: Dhāda the sheep means turning, restraining, or keeping them from moving; a dhawd of camels is a small group.
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r8.anchor: ذاد الشياه: أمالها عن المشي، يذودها ذودا: إذا حبسها عنه ومنعها

JISHUMI:v8p5484/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r9.speaker: أبو عبيد
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r9.claim: Abu Ubayd defines a dhawd of camels as thirty to ninety females, excluding males.
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r9.anchor: وقال أبو عبيد: ما بين الثلاثين إلى التسعين من الإناث دون الذكور.

JISHUMI:v8p5484/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r10.claim: The singular of riʿāʾ is rāʿ, like tājir/tujjār; its other plurals are ruʿāt and ruʿyān.
JISHUMI:v8p5484/r10.anchor: واحد الرعاء: راع، مثل: تاجر وتجار، ويجمع: رعاة ورعيان.

MUQATIL:28:20-23/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r7.speaker: author
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r7.claim: The water was named for Midian, son of Abraham the Friend of God.
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r7.anchor: ابن إبراهيم خليل الرحمن لصلبه، عليهم السلام

MUQATIL:28:20-23/r8.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r8.speaker: author
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r8.claim: Moses found a group watering their sheep, and two women holding their flock back to water after the shepherds left.
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r8.anchor: يقول: وجد موسى على الماء جماعة

MUQATIL:28:20-23/r9.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r9.speaker: author
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r9.claim: The women were Shuayb’s twin daughters, Sabura and Abra; the elder was born half a day earlier. They waited until shepherds returned to pasture, then watered leftover water because their aged father could not.
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r9.anchor: يعني حابستين الغنم لتسقي فضل ماء الرعاء، وهما ابنتا شعيب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

MUQATIL:28:20-23/r10.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r10.speaker: author
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r10.claim: Moses’s question means “What is your situation?” They say they do not water until the shepherds leave.
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r10.anchor: لهما موسى: { ما خطبكما } يعني ما أمركما

MUQATIL:28:20-23/r11.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r11.speaker: author
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r11.claim: Moses asked where the water was, lifted alone a well-covering stone that required a group, drew a bucket into the basin, and prayed for blessing.
MUQATIL:28:20-23/r11.anchor: لا يزيله إلا عصابة من الناس، فرفعه موسى، عليه السلام، وحده بيده
